name: @despia-native/live
description: The live-logs relay (proposals/live-logs.md 3.2): one Cloudflare Worker plus one Durable Object class a developer deploys to their own Cloudflare account. Devices batch-POST scrubbed log rows; viewers read them back over an SSE cursor feed; sealed .dsxreport uploads are stored and verified. Despia operates nothing - the relay runs on the developer's account and bills there.
